  • Speech, network results and incoming messages are simulated; the site never uses your mic or radio.
  • Voice yields one final sample transcript. No streaming transcript or automatic send is implied.
  • The language list matches the eight options in the current Android selector. Kannada and Malayalam are target languages, but not current selector options.
  • A successful transport write appears in Logs as Awaiting ACK; only an ACK changes it to Delivered.
  • Sample history uses today’s date and local clock format. New messages use your browser’s local time.
  • This review keeps changes in this browser tab across reloads. Reset restores the selected starting history.
